description: Common structure every VC5A prompt-dag fixture validates against. `input.scenario` names the build/validate condition the acceptance test executes against the REAL prompt-dag module (src/vector-cortex/prompt-dag/{builder,validator}.js); `input.graph` names a declaratively-described DAG the test materializes (no byte payload embedded). `expected.ok` pins a clean build/validate (optionally the exact topological `order`); failure rows pin an exact `code` (DAG_MIXED_SESSION / DAG_DUPLICATE_ID / DAG_MISSING_ENDPOINT / DAG_INVALID_SPAN / DAG_SPAN_DIGEST_CONFLICT / DAG_REVERSED_PRECEDES / DAG_CYCLE / DAG_TOOL_PAIR_SPLIT / DAG_UNKNOWN_INCOMPATIBLE).
title: VC5A PromptDagV1 fixture envelope
